keyVerseDR: "This is my beloved son. Hear him." (Lk 9:35)

level1.title: Jesus Shines
level1.story: Jesus went up a mountain to pray with Peter, John, and James. While He prayed, His face changed and His clothes shone white. A voice said, "This is My chosen Son. Listen to Him!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you listen to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me listen to You. Amen.

activity.title: Shining glory
activity.intro: Connect the dots to make a shining star.

level2.title: The Transfiguration
level2.story: Jesus took Peter, John, and James up a mountain to pray. While He prayed, His face changed, and His clothing became white and glittering. Moses and Elijah appeared in glory and spoke of His death that He would accomplish in Jerusalem. Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep, but they woke and saw His glory. A cloud came and a voice said, "This is My beloved Son; hear Him."
level2.keyLine: This is my beloved son. Hear him.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What were Moses and Elijah talking about?
level2.prayer: Jesus, let me see Your glory and listen. Amen.

activity.title: Pictograms
activity.intro: Draw a simple picture for each key word: Mountain, Prayer, Glory.
activity.prompt: Three small pictures: a mountain, Jesus praying, and shining glory

art.mainBrief: Jesus praying on mountain, face shining, Moses and Elijah
art.heartBrief: Sun rays radiating from heart; cloud at top
